title: Sections over a w-contractible affine are exact
statement:
Let $U=\operatorname{Spec}D$ with $D$ w-contractible be an object of $X_{\mathrm{proét}}$,
and let $\mathcal R$ be a sheaf of rings on $X_{\mathrm{proét}}$. The functor
$\Gamma(U,-)\colon F\mapsto F(U)$ from abelian sheaves (or from sheaves of
$\mathcal R$-modules) to abelian groups (or $\mathcal R(U)$-modules) is exact.

proof.text:
Kernels of sheaves of modules are computed sectionwise, so $\Gamma(U,-)$ is left exact. Let
$F\to G$ be an epimorphism of abelian sheaves (or of $\mathcal R$-modules). It is an
epimorphism of the underlying sheaves of sets (cokernels of sheaves of modules are
sheafified presheaf cokernels, so surjectivity in either sense means local surjectivity on
sections). By [det-pe-wcb-projective], $F(U)\to G(U)$ is surjective. A left exact functor
preserving epimorphisms is exact.
